definitionZh: 反重置的CSS属性创建了命名为CSS的计数器并初始化为特定值. 它支持创建从一个数到数的计数器,以及从一个数到数的计数器.
sourceDefinition: The counter-reset CSS property creates named CSS counters and initializes them to a specific value. It supports creating counters that count up from one to the number of elements, as well as those that count down from the number of elements to one.
